name: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.2
changelog: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.2! Enhanced mouse cursor management: completely suppresses cursor on Linux/X11/Wayland/SteamOS using hardware transparent blank cursor bitmap and SDL visibility; adds 15px idle anchor jitter filtering for Steam Deck trackpads and gyro; adds instant cursor auto-hide upon any controller/gamepad button or stick input; cleanly auto-hides after 2 seconds idle.
